notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). The package is a GymnasiumDriver for the registered environment Robocasa-Rl-G1LiftObjStateRL (lw_benchhub_rl/__init__.py:18-27), the Unitree G1 cube-lift task of LW-BenchHub. native is the card's entry symbol lw_benchhub_tasks.lightwheel_robocasa_tasks.single_stage.lift_obj:LiftObj: the environment class the registration names is isaaclab.envs:ManagerBasedRLEnv, which is not a card entry symbol, so the task class is the honest native and the fake stands in for the single environment gym.make would build. The five G7.MAYBE_ABSENT warnings are the Gymnasium environment interface (action_space, observation_space, reset, step, close), which the base outside the clone provides; the fake implements only that surface and no other public members. No hardware backend exists and no hardware was attached or run. The upstream environment was not installed or run: it needs the Isaac Sim 5.0 and Isaac Lab GPU stack from install.sh (README.md:42-46), so the sim backend (gymnasium.make of the registered id) was not exercised and no GPU result is claimed. The fake is a pure-Python analytic stand-in, not Isaac Sim, PhysX, the kitchen scene, the G1 USD articulation or the Dex3 hand; its dynamics, reward and the joint/pose values are test data marked # placeholder and were never compared with the upstream environment. Action: the upstream ManagerBasedRLEnv builds an unbounded Box from the action manager (Isaac Lab submodule, not part of the pinned parent tree), and the stand-in uses 8 numbers for one environment (the seven right-arm joints of g1.py:194-197 plus one binary Dex3 hand command, dex3.py:72-79 with scale 1 and use_default_offset). No numeric limit is declared because the upstream action space has none; G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE is therefore correct, and G8.NO_UNIT x4 are the expected integer/number inputs the bridge derives (seed twice, ticks, action.values[*]). Observation: the real observation space is a Dict of batched Boxes computed at run time by the observation manager; the fake publishes a 104-number 'policy' stand-in (43 joint positions + 43 joint velocities + 7 object pose command + 8 last actions + 3 object position), which is the real size this package assumes and names here. NOT COVERED: the other observation groups, camera and image observations, PhysX contacts, rendering, the G1 USD and Dex3 hand fidelity, and the upstream 8.0 s episode beyond the fake's 400-tick stand-in. Fidelity contract: isaaclab, F1, seeded (seed_control parameter; the fake repeats a seed, no bit-identical GPU contact solving is claimed), 20 ms control timestep from base.py:241,247,249 (the 10 ms physics substep is a gap), realtime_factor 0, lockstep, full reset, no snapshot/restore, and the gaps list the unmodelled engine and scenes. Safety is the runtime's software e-stop latch: the upstream ManagerBasedRLEnv has no native stop, so no native stop is claimed; after an e-stop no step or reset is accepted until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, and the state stays readable. Warnings: G1.CLONE_NOTE is the host's case-insensitive file system reporting the case-colliding X7S.usd/x7s.usd paths as sharing one file; the clone was not written to and no restore was attempted. G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL is the seed class (it only sets the next reset's seed). No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning remains. The package is model-authored and unreviewed: driver.lock.json authored_by is kind model (deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017, run wD-084) and reviewed_by is null; no human reviewed or tested anything, and no hardware run is claimed. publish_review is required because the upstream licence is NOASSERTION (task.json licence_class unknown): publication is the owner's decision. Only catalogue classes cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue_requests. gate.digest is the digest line the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
